name: Md. Yeamin
intro:
I'm an Environmental Science graduate from Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP), currently working as Executive – Project & Sustainability at Textile Today Innovation Hub (TTIH), focusing on ZDHC project implementation, sustainable chemical management, wastewater management, and factory sustainability.



Through my internship at GREENBUD, I gained practical experience in environmental monitoring, industrial inspections, EIA & EMP documentation, GHG and ODS inventory preparation, environmental data analysis, technical reporting, and environmental compliance assessment.



My technical knowledge includes ISO 14001:2015 EMS, ISO 14064-1, EIA & EMP, GHG Protocol and Bangladesh environmental regulations. I aim to contribute to sustainability, ZDHC implementation, environmental compliance, EHS/HSE, ESG, and environmental consultancy.
